title: Federal learning method and system for meeting personalized privacy protection requirements of participants

pse.problem: Privacy leakage in federated learning due to gradients or model parameters uploaded by participants being analyzable by attackers using methods like differential attacks and model inversion attacks.
pse.solution_function: Federated learning method based on differential privacy aims to protect user data privacy while allowing model training across multiple devices. It modifies the uploaded gradients or model parameters with noise to prevent leakage of sensitive information.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of participating devices, each containing local data and a device-specific model, and a central aggregation server responsible for collecting and averaging the perturbed gradients from all participants.
pse.solution_implementation: Local differential privacy adds noise to parameters before uploading, while centralized differential privacy modifies the central aggregation server's processing of collected gradients. The noise level is adjusted based on the user's sensitivity level and privacy requirements.
pse.effect: The method reduces the risk of privacy leakage in federated learning and provides flexible privacy protection tailored to individual users.
